extracted.name: Sarah's Homemade Applesauce
extracted.description: This applesauce recipe is easy to make from scratch with apples, sugar, and cinnamon for a delicious topping on pancakes, ice cream, or pork chops.
instruction_lines: Combine apples, water, sugar, and cinnamon in a saucepan; cover and cook over medium heat until apples are soft, stirring occasionally, 15 to 20 minutes.
Allow apple mixture to cool, then mash with a fork or potato masher until reaches desired consistency.
